purpose: Research-only three-level access grades. NOT read by the app. catalog/map_points/WA.json stays verified|pending; 'access-verified' here is the source of the proposed middle tier (docs/proposed-access-verified-schema.md). Never merge into the catalog.

levels.verified: official launch/ramp GIS point, or official boating access + ramp/path clearly visible in imagery; mirrors catalog/map_points/WA.json
levels.access-verified: official/land-manager source explicitly names boating/launching/put-in at the site; exact water entry not pinned (approximate area)
levels.pending: only AW/OSM/outfitter/informal or uncertain access; or official source mentions only park/trail/activity/generic river access; or closure/construction uncertainty
